// defect: `./beta` exports `PctBetaItem` under a second name, `PctAItem`, that sorts before every other key, and `PctBeta` under a third, `PctZBeta`, that sorts after every other. The row measures `PctBetaItem`, imported as `PctAItem` — the class an alias put first, not the first by its own name. Measured on the real `./select`: `PctSelect as PctASelect` turned its probe from `PctMultiSelect` alone (52064 B) to `PctSelect` alone (51887 B), and the row changed direction with no line of code saying so.
message: the row of `./beta` names `PctBetaItem`, and the first tag of the entrypoint by its own name is `PctBeta`: PctBeta (as PctB, PctBeta, PctZBeta), PctBetaItem (as PctAItem, PctBetaItem).
